__doc__: Pre-existing SERIOUS/CRITICAL axe violations pinned when the accessibility sweep was added to the surface-smoke gate (S0b-2, 2026-07-22). Each entry downgrades ONE screen + RULE + width combination from failure to a logged warning, so the gate can land while the defect is owed to a fix wave. Pins are per-RULE on purpose: pinning color-contrast on a screen does NOT grandfather a new label violation on that same screen. RATCHET RULE: entries are only ever REMOVED (the test logs PINNED ENTRY NOW PASSING the moment a pinned rule stops firing; delete it in the change that fixed it). Never add an entry for a NEW defect you just shipped - fix it instead. To regenerate after a fix wave: run pnpm test:smoke and collect the AXE-FINDING {...} lines the run emits.
__scope__: axe covers roughly 30-40% of real accessibility defects. A clean run here is necessary, never sufficient; canon 05 and the ux-* auditors own the rest.

entries.reason: Serious contrast failures (up to 3 nodes) at every width. Text and control colors come from the ds.css tokens, so this is ONE token-level fix across the app rather than a per-page repair; pinning per surface keeps the ratchet honest about which screens still carry it. Pre-existing; found by the S0b-2 axe sweep 2026-07-22, which changed no product code.
